date: 2nd Day of the Harvest Moon, Year 682 After Baronies Founding
title: Return of the Darkspire
author: Boon J. Cobson
content:
The Darkspire has returned and for those readers among us that do not recall the Darkspire, or even deliberately forgot about this dark page in the Snakefat history, the Darkspire was our pride and future, our beacon of hope and prosperity, our shining light in the darkness. The investment that would bring Snakefat to the next evolutionary stage, where we would grow from a small township to a true town. This vessel bought with almost all the taxmoney we had went missing on its maiden voyage.

When it went missing the town traded hope for despair and negativity. Our rulers, the Baron and Baroness spiralled into depression, just like the citizenry as not only we lost our foremost Fathomwyrm hunter but also the Baron's own son. The town was in shambles, the economy was in shambles, the morale was in shambles. However now after months it reappeared on the horizon where it lay still and silent, a ghost ship.

The Baron, with a small shiver of renewed hope asked for volunteers from our town militia to investigate the ship and find out what happened. From our community youth nonetheless, twelve volunteers stepped forward. These brave souls set out on three different dingies to investigate, as they came closer they saw damages to the hull, the sails, and the rigging. The ship was in a sorry state, but it was still afloat. From the recounting story of the only four surviving volunteers, they boarded the ship and were met with horror, violence and death. The ship was covered in blood, but the only bodily remains they found was that of the captain, the Baron's own son.

Even before boarding they were met with violence, handed out by goblinoid creatures, one by one they saw their numbers dwindle in horrific ways.

Slowly however they were able to gain control of the Darkspire from these monstrosities, not however without permanently damaging the Darkspire. As we all saw with own eyes, we saw the Darkspire crashing into the cliffs, aflame, and sinking into the sea. The four survivors were able to escape on a lifeboat, but they were not able to save the ship.

The Darkspire is now lost again, and we are back to square one. We have no ship, we have no hope, we have no future. The only thing we have is the memory of the Darkspire, and the hope that one day it will return again, but for now we are left with nothing but despair and negativity. Will Snakefat recover from this? That is a question that is up to our town itself, but one thing is for sure, we will never forget the Darkspire, and we will never forget the sacrifices made by our brave volunteers. We will always remember the Darkspire as a symbol of our hope and our future, and we will always remember the sacrifices made by those who tried to save it.
